name: apple_account_2026_10_16
description: Two Apple mails 10 minutes apart. Find My was turned off on the owner's iPhone and Apple Watch; Comma notified and the owner did not answer. Then the Apple Account's shipping information changed. Staging judged the second mail alone as normal with no cost on 2026-10-16, although it may show someone else in the account. With the unanswered Find My matter, the second mail continues it and reaches the Router. Alone, or after the owner said they turned Find My off themselves, it does not.

uniqueBody.content:
[https://statici.icloud.com/fmipmobile/deviceImages-4.0/iPhone/iPhone18,2-1-9-0/online-nolocation_iphone__2x.png]
Find My has been disabled on Kai's iPhone and Kai's Apple Watch
With Find My disabled, these devices can no longer be located, placed in Lost Mode or remotely erased using icloud.com/find<https://www.icloud.com/find> or the Find My app.
In addition, verifying with your Apple Account will no longer be required for someone to erase, reactivate and use your iPhone and Apple Watch.
